DitherTunnel.rings: How close together the rings are: 2 packs twice as many in.
DitherTunnel.spokes: Lines running along the walls, 0 to 32. 0 leaves only the rings.
DitherTunnel.center: The vanishing point, as fractions of the box from the top left.
DitherTunnel.sway: How far the vanishing point wanders. 0 holds it still.
DitherTunnel.fog: Size of the empty fog in the middle: 2 doubles it to clear room for text.
